explication: OGX is a model-agnostic, OpenAI-compatible agentic API server. A client request enters the server and API routes, then inference or Responses handling can use configured providers; the product also exposes document/vector search, batches, skills, and native Anthropic and Google APIs. The graph includes the server’s stack and provider layer, plus the CLI and web UI as distinct product surfaces. Unexcerpted subsystems are included where the README documents them; their internal call paths are not assumed.
